biography.blurb: Based in Los Angeles, James Axon is a musically studied and deep-digging DJ known for introducing dance floors to new sounds and new music, equally often through cutting-edge new releases as through the forgotten and obscure gems of the past.
biography.content:
James Axon is a DJ, musician, and creator of the LA-based queer underground party Planet Love, as well as a resident on Dublab with his radio show Hearing Color. A lifelong pianist turned obsessive record collector, James Axon approaches DJing as an extension of musicianship. Before falling into house and techno, he spent years in bands and orchestral ensembles, a background that still shapes the way he thinks about rhythm, harmony, and structuring his sets compositionally. 

As a keyboardist and musician, he has collaborated with Seven Davis Jr. and Massimiliano Pagliara, and as a DJ has shared lineups with the likes of Octo Octa, Eris Drew,  Avalon Emerson,The Blessed Madonna, Derrick Carter, Paramida, Peach, Moxie, Alex Kassian, Zombies in Miami, Jennifer Loveless, Sally C, Tornado Wallace, Perel, Eli Escobar, Paurro, and more. 

His sets drift seamlessly between house, techno, italo, electro, disco, and breaks, guided by an expansive taste shaped by pioneering artists like Aphex Twin, Kraftwerk, Giorgio Moroder, Jeff Mills, Laurent Garnier, Andrew Weatherall, and Francois Kevorkian. His sets are always colorful, eclectic, and intuitively reflective of the setting -- whether playing cosmic disco in an intimate loft or hypnotic techno in a dark foggy warehouse, he still finds a sound that is distinctly James Axon: melodic and synth-heavy, driving and dreamy.

200.description:
One Resident Advisor event: title, local date and times with IANA time zone, status, venue with address and coordinates, lineup, artists, genres, promoters, description, images, promotional links, and the public primary ticket tiers RA lists anonymously: title, retail price, booking fee, currency, sale status (`VALID` on sale, `NOTYETONSALE`, `NOLONGERONSALE`, `SOLDOUT`, ...), on-sale window, add-on flag, plus RA's `any_tier_available` snapshot. Prices are per ticket as RA states them; whether the service fee is included in the retail price is not exposed by the API and is reported as `fees: unknown`. Resale offers, allocation and remaining quantities need an RA login and are not covered. Availability is a snapshot, not a reservation.

post.description: Discover events by city and date; take `area_id` from `areas` and chain each `events[].id` into `event` for tickets.

area_id.description:
RA area id from `areas` (8 New York City, 34 Berlin, 13 London, 1 Sydney). RA stores area ids as 16-bit integers.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 32767.

date_from.description: First local listing date, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today (UTC). Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

date_to.description: Last local listing date, inclusive. Default: `date_from` + 7 days; at most 366 days after `date_from`. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

page.description:
1-based page; use `next_page` from the previous response.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 200.

page_size.description:
Rows per page, default 20.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 50.

query.description: Keyword matched against event titles within the area and window.

sort.description:
`date`: RA's listing order (listing date, then relevance score, then title). `popularity`: most attending first. Default `date`.

Provider reference: allowed values ["date", "popularity"].
